_note: CONSTRUCTED FOR TEACHING. This incident did not happen: it is a made-up record for ailab lab m11, and Najm Remit and Najm Bank are fictional too. All times are UTC (Qatar is UTC+3). The record says what it says and nothing more.
title: Customers did not receive their transfer-sent message for 52 minutes

timeline.text: First notification.failed event of the day: template transfer_sent, reason notification_error.
Alert fired: notification failure rate above 20% for 10 minutes. The on-call SRE was paged.
The on-call SRE acknowledged the page.
The on-call SRE opened INC-2031 in the payments incidents channel and set the severity to SEV3. Maha took the incident commander role.
A payments engineer read the audit log: transfers were still completing, and every notification.failed event had reason notification_error.
The notification gateway vendor's public status page posted: 'Investigating delayed message delivery.'
The customer support lead said callers were asking where their confirmation was, and asked for a line to give them.
A notice was added to the Najm app: 'Your transfer goes through even if the confirmation message is late.'
Last notification.failed event of the window.
The alert resolved on its own.
The vendor's status page posted: 'Resolved. Message delivery is back to normal.'
A payments engineer finished a reconciliation of the window: 188 transfers checked, the ledger and the store agree for all of them, 0 mismatches.

baseline.window: 09:58 to 10:50 UTC on 2026-03-04, one week earlier
